title: SVNautics SMP
description: This server is a create-based smp, It have been currently released with Create: Aeronautics and some diesel and electric things.
body:
## 📌 About This Project

This project is a **Create-based SMP (Survival Multiplayer) server** focused on automation, engineering, and creative building using the Create mod ecosystem.

It currently features **Create: Aeronautics**, along with additional **diesel and electric-themed content**, allowing players to build advanced machines, vehicles, and automated systems.

---

## ⚙️ What This Project Adds

• A multiplayer survival experience centered around the **Create mod**
• Ability to build **automated factories and mechanical systems**
• **Airships and flying machines** using Create: Aeronautics
• Integration of **diesel and electric technology elements**
• A collaborative environment for technical and creative players

---

## ⭐ Why You Should Join

If you enjoy automation, engineering, and large-scale builds, this server offers a unique experience combining creativity with technical gameplay.

You can:
• Design complex machines
• Experiment with moving contraptions
• Build efficient production systems
• Play with others in a tech-focused SMP

---

## ⚠️ Important Information

• This server is currently **Work In Progress (WIP)**
• Features, mods, and systems may change over time
• Some mechanics may not be fully optimized yet
• Expect updates, improvements, and new content

---

## 🌍 Accessibility

This description is provided in **English** and is written in plain text for clarity and accessibility.

---

## 🚀 Summary

A technology-focused SMP built around the Create mod, featuring automation, airships, and diesel/electric systems, designed for players who enjoy engineering and creative survival gameplay.
